title: Treatise on the Whipped Dart
summary: Teaches the whipping cast, where coiled qi in the spine snaps the board forward and cracks the dart away.

title: Handbook of Qi-Lead Casting
summary: Trains the thrower to cast ahead of moving foes, using qi-sense to read their line and correct each dart.

title: Canon of the Long Reach Cast
summary: Extends the thrower's range with full arm reach, leg drive and heavy darts that fall on distant marks.

title: The Pinning Dart Manual
summary: Shows how to fasten a foe's boot, hem or sleeve to the ground or a post with a dart.

title: Workbook of Running Throws
summary: Drills casting at the run and from a sudden stop, and backward at a pursuer, with qi steadying the arm.

title: Rules of the Dart Skirmish Line
summary: Sets out how a line of throwers keeps its interval, rolls its casts and covers one another while reloading.

title: Treatise on Dart Volley Timing
summary: Explains the counted beats of a volley, so several darts land together and a lone thrower seems many.

title: Manual of the Beast-Hunting Cast
summary: Teaches the heavy dart and the patient cast used against large beasts, with ways to turn their charge.
